entries.headline: JJ Bleday came close
entries.story: JJ Bleday went 1-for-4 against Ryan Gusto and the Miami Marlins. Closest call was a double in the 5th: "JJ Bleday doubles (13) on a ground ball to right fielder Esteury Ruiz." The power showed up; the carry did not.
